concerns.text: Task T001.1 (Update Plan) is listed as a dependency for T035 (ANOVA), but T001.1 itself depends on T012-Runtime. However, T035 also depends on T001.1. This creates a circular dependency risk if T035 is executed before the Plan is updated. The Plan update (T001.1) must be a hard prerequisite for the ANOVA implementation (T035) to ensure the 'Single Source of Truth' is consistent before analysis code is written. The current ordering implies T035 might run before T001.1 completes if not strictly enforced.

Task T012-Sens (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, the task description states it must 'Vary effect size across a range... and calculate required sample size'. This is a sequential calculation process dependent on the output of T012.0. Marking it [P] is misleading as it cannot run in parallel with T012-Calc or other power analysis tasks without shared state or race conditions on the output file `data/analysis/sensitivity_analysis.json`.

Task T012-Calc depends on T012-Sens, but T012-Sens is marked [P]. If T012-Sens is executed in parallel with T012-Calc (due to the [P] tag), T012-Calc may attempt to read `data/analysis/sensitivity_analysis.json` before T012-Sens has finished writing it, causing a race condition or file-not-found error. The [P] tag must be removed from T012-Sens to enforce strict sequential ordering: T012.0 -> T012-Sens -> T012-Calc.

Task T015 (Enhanced detail compositing) depends on T015.1-Run (Asset Generation). However, T015.1-Run is marked [X] (completed) in the list, while T015 is also marked [X]. The dependency chain T015.1-Script -> T015.1-Run -> T015 is correct, but the [P] tag on T015.1-Script is valid only if it doesn't depend on T006.3-Filter. T015.1-Script has 'Dependency: None', which is correct. However, T015 depends on T006.3-Filter (Data Fetch). If T006.3-Filter fails (terminal failure), T015 cannot proceed. The ordering is correct, but the [P] tag on T015.1-Script is safe.

Task T027.2 (Generate Recognition Questions) depends on T017 (Stimulus Metadata Generation). T017 is in Phase 2 (Foundational), and T027.2 is in Phase 4 (US2). This is correct. However, T027.2 also depends on T006.3-Filter. If T006.3-Filter is not completed before T027.2, the task will fail. The ordering is correct, but the dependency on T006.3-Filter must be strictly enforced.

Task T035 (ANOVA) depends on T001.1 (Plan Update). T001.1 depends on T012-Runtime. T012-Runtime depends on T012-Calc. This chain is correct. However, T035 also depends on T038 (Dataset-variable fit check). T038 depends on T017 and T027.3. T027.3 depends on T027.2. T027.2 depends on T017 and T006.3-Filter. The ordering is complex but appears correct. The critical issue is the [P] tag on T012-Sens, which breaks the sequential flow of the power analysis.
Task T012-Sens is marked [P] but describes a sequential calculation process. The [P] tag should be removed to prevent parallel execution that could lead to race conditions on the output file.
